result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but lacks high-visibility markings and dedicated pedestrian signals. The presence of parked vehicles near the corners creates potential sightline obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection on the far side of the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection corners can block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both the left and right sides of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing zone.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the long crossing distance across four lanes of traffic without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are visible but appear faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental-style high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk across a two-lane road in a mixed-use area. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of active traffic control or pedestrian refuge islands increases exposure risk for those crossing.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks signals or stop signs to prioritize pedestrian movement on a relatively wide road.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may obscure pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the red car.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: RRFB Installation
interventions.description: Add Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the crosswalk.
